args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living vs Covey & Lark
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on a label mix-up for the Pellow Home Living (PHL) account:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing in reporting.
- Anyone searching for the account under the old name may be looking in the wrong place, so the report label needs updating.

Could you let me know who owns the report label change, or whether the deal desk needs to act on it?

Thanks,
Sofia

args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A quick note on a label mix-up for the Pellow Home Living (PHL) account:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the old name is still showing in reporting.
- Anyone searching for the account under the old name may be looking in the wrong place, so the report label needs updating.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Could you let me know who owns the report label change, or whether the deal desk needs to act on it?

Thanks,
Sofia (drafted with Bettina)
